fieldEnabledDesc: When enabled, the AI assistant uses the provider and models below
fieldApiEndpointDesc: Use the provider base URL (e.g. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1, Gemini: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai)
fieldApiKeyDesc: API key for the AI service, stored encrypted in this instance.
fieldApiKeyDescConfigured: API key is configured, leave empty to keep existing key
fieldModelsPlaceholder: Search models or enter a custom model
modelSelectNoOptions: No model options yet; fetch or enter one manually
noDetectedModels: No models detected, please input manually
compactionDesc: When a conversation nears the model's context limit, earlier turns are sent as a summary. The full history is kept; compaction costs one extra model call.
contextWindowDesc: Context length your model accepts, e.g. 128, 200, 1000
thresholdDesc: Compact when a request reaches this share of the window
keepTurnsDesc: The latest turns are always sent verbatim
